ov: The second-largest deer after the moose, native to North America and Central and East Asia. Its other name, wapiti, comes from a Shawnee and Cree word for "white rump". Males grow large antlers and shed them every year.

why.et: Hunted as game; its meat is leaner and higher in protein than beef or chicken.

rg: North America and Central, East and North Asia; introduced to Argentina and New Zealand.
df: Grasses and sedges, plus leaves, twigs and bark.
fx: A bull’s bugle can reach 4,000 Hz, unusually high for such a large animal.
Wild elk average 10–13 years; in captivity they can live 20 years or more.
